parts:

I am both new at using R, Shiny and javascript (hard to learn many things altogether) although I have been trying to create a widget "rpivottable" via your tutorial "Lesson 1 - How to build a JavaScript based widget". My apologizes in advance if my question looks stupid or easy... I think I miss some basics.

4) Modify the r.file "rpivotTable" with:

#' <Add Title>
#'
#' <Add Description>
#'
#' @import htmlwidgets
#'
#' @export
rpivotTable <- function(message, width = NULL, height = NULL, elementId = NULL) {

  # forward options using x
  x = list(
    data = message
  )

  # create widget
  htmlwidgets::createWidget(
    name = 'rpivotTable',
    x,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    package = 'rpivot',
    elementId = elementId
  )
}

#' Shiny bindings for rpivotTable
#'
#' Output and render functions for using rpivotTable within Shiny
#' applications and interactive Rmd documents.
#'
#' @param outputId output variable to read from
#' @param width,height Must be a valid CSS unit (like \code{'100\%'},
#'   \code{'400px'}, \code{'auto'}) or a number, which will be coerced to a
#'   string and have \code{'px'} appended.
#' @param expr An expression that generates a rpivotTable
#' @param env The environment in which to evaluate \code{expr}.
#' @param quoted Is \code{expr} a quoted expression (with \code{quote()})? This
#'   is useful if you want to save an expression in a variable.
#'
#' @name rpivotTable-shiny
#'
#' @export
rpivotTableOutput <- function(outputId, width = '100%', height = '400px'){
  htmlwidgets::shinyWidgetOutput(outputId, 'rpivotTable', width, height, package = 'rpivot')
}

#' @rdname rpivotTable-shiny
#' @export
renderRpivotTable <- function(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE) {
  if (!quoted) { expr <- substitute(expr) } # force quoted
  htmlwidgets::shinyRenderWidget(expr, rpivotTableOutput, env, quoted = TRUE)
}

---

However, while writing: rpivotTable(Titanic) in R, I get "undefined" in the browser.. I know if I simply download "rpivotTable" library in R and write rpivotTable(Titanic) I get the proper rpivottable in R. But I need to create the widget this way because afterwards, I have to modify some scripts to make rows/columns collapse and expand via the following code available here https://github.com/nagarajanchinnasamy/pivottable-subtotal-renderer:

$(function(){
    $.getJSON("mps.json", function(mps) {
        $("#output").pivotUI(mps, {
            dataClass: $.pivotUtilities.SubtotalPivotData,
            rows: ["Gender", "Province"],
            cols: ["Party", "Age"],
            renderers: $.pivotUtilities.subtotal_renderers,
            rendererName: "Table With Subtotal",
            rendererOptions: {
                collapseColsAt: 0
            }

});
